title: Setting Up Webhooks and Zapier for Lead Export

sections.heading: Lead Webhook Export
sections.content:
You can export customer inquiries, member signups, and reviews in real-time to CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho) via Webhooks and Zapier.
1. Navigate to Settings > Webhooks.
2. Click 'Add New Webhook'.
3. Select Trigger Event: 'New Member Signup', 'Lead Generated', or 'Payment Completed'.
4. Enter the destination Target Webhook URL (e.g. Zapier webhook endpoint).
5. Click 'Activate Webhook'.

procedural_steps: Select trigger event (New Member, Lead Generated)
full_text:
Lead Webhook Export
You can export customer inquiries, member signups, and reviews in real-time to CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho) via Webhooks and Zapier.
1. Navigate to Settings > Webhooks.
2. Click 'Add New Webhook'.
3. Select Trigger Event: 'New Member Signup', 'Lead Generated', or 'Payment Completed'.
4. Enter the destination Target Webhook URL (e.g. Zapier webhook endpoint).
5. Click 'Activate Webhook'.
